svg.title: FB_Valve1 - test V2: jam, alarm 1 after tMove = 2000 ms, reset, retry
svg.text: FB_Valve1 - test V2: jam, alarm 1 after tMove = 2000 ms, reset, retry
Blue = inputs (end switches, command, reset), black = outputs. The error does NOT switch qSol off: the module decides the reaction from the alarm class (D3).
tick k (x 100 ms) - events change inputs before the call of that tick
tick 2: command B, cylinder leaves A (PosA 0), moving, n counts from 1 ; tick 21: n = 20 -> 20 x 100 = 2000 >= tMove -> alarm 1 'end position not reached' ;
tick 30: rising edge of xReset, both switches not on -> error cleared, moving = NOT reached = TRUE (retry, n restarts) ; tick 36: PosB -> reached, busy off.
